en: A black and white postcard depicting a small train station building with a few people standing in front and a train visible on the right. The station is surrounded by trees and there is a railway signal in the foreground. The text at the bottom reads 'Skäralid, Jernvägsstationen.' There is handwritten text in Swedish along the right and top edges. The left edge has the publisher's mark: 'Kullbergs Bokhandel No. 155. Import.'
